g.text: Which basin is charged is set by convention, not measurement

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: The same physical electricity, attributed six standard ways — ordered by how wide the accounting boundary is drawn

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Computable conventions span 0.87%–43.32% — a factor of 50. Fleet: all 243 buildings, full buildout.

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: The three averages differ only in where the boundary is drawn, and Lake Anna's share falls as it widens: Virginia holds 23.2% of eGRID SERC nuclear

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: (EPA eGRID2023) and 11.7% of PJM nuclear (JLARC App. H ÷ PJM SOM Table 3-63), so each convention is scaled by that share — unscaled, a Virginia-only

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: plant map returns 52.3% and 45.4% and inverts the result. Short-run marginal is lowest for a different reason: nuclear is baseload and rarely responds to

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: new demand. Long-run marginal is cited from JLARC/E3, not recomputed; its new nuclear is unsited SMRs, not North Anna.
